text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A in stages at large gains realized profits, but a gain versus my average cost alone does not show whether selling is best; I should consider the portfolio and my plan.","Repeatedly trimming Stock A reduced my exposure to a strong past performer, but that does not mean its next move is predictable; I should avoid chasing or extrapolating its rise.","My account value still fluctuated despite the gains on Stock A, so I should monitor overall risk and diversification rather than judge decisions by one position's returns."]}
